about.title: About
about.text: A cultural space open to the world, at the heart of Brussels. A living space of encounter and dialogue around languages, arts and cultural identities.

quote: Italy, its language and artistic heritage, an active bridge with other worlds, experiences and imaginaries.

mission_preview.title: Our Mission
mission_preview.text: Promote the Italian language and culture in all their richness and contemporaneity. Facilitate intercultural dialogue to build inclusive societies.

mission.title: Our Vision and Mission
mission.p1: Our vision is to become an essential cultural bridge in Europe, connecting Italy's rich traditions with global cultural dynamics. We imagine a space where art, language and identity are tools for social inclusion and mutual understanding.
mission.objective1_text: Promote the Italian language and culture through courses and interactive events.
mission.objective2_text: Facilitate intercultural dialogue to build inclusive and open societies.
mission.objective3_text: Democratize access to culture without economic, linguistic or social barriers.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: We are based in Brussels. Feel free to contact us for questions or collaboration proposals.
